name: @lenticule-science/mathematical-readout-exchange
description: A2A boundary for normalized relational-graph metrology and siloxane-zeolite rigidity simulation.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: an A2A RMN request naming a normalized finite relational graph or a siloxane-zeolite rigidity simulation
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: invalid input, source drift, or an unqualified equivalence claim

obsmetrologia.relationalGraph.readout.accepts: { vertices: string[], edges: [string,string][] } — at least one explicitly sorted unique vertex and canonical sorted unique simple edges
obsmetrologia.relationalGraph.readout.returns: { entities, cells, components, componentPartition, h0rank, h1rank, coordinationFree, landauerBits, coordinationCost, exactRank, harmonicRank, cost, certificate }

obsmetrologia.siloxaneZeolite.rigiditySu.accepts: { conductivityGrid: number[][], sigmaMatrix: number > 0, thresholds: number[] in [0,1] }
obsmetrologia.siloxaneZeolite.rigiditySu.returns: { model: 'surrogate2d', phiGrid, sweep, limitations } — planar 4-neighbor generic 2-D rigidity assay only

obsmetrologia.generic2d.pebbleJudgment.accepts: { atomId: string, vertices: unique string[], contacts: unique undirected [string,string][] } — the caller supplies the exact named causal cone and contact relation
obsmetrologia.generic2d.pebbleJudgment.returns: { model, atomId, vertices, accepted, rejected, scope, limitations } — generic planar (2,3) independence only; never a grid-to-atom, 3-D, MD, or DFT claim

scripts.verify: node src/verify-enterprise.mjs && node --check bin/serve-a2a.mjs && node --check bin/execute-a2a-task.mjs && node --check src/relational-graph.mjs && node --check src/relational-graph-protocol.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs
